decisions.reason: Locates the disabled expression, explains busy is local to sibling AttachButton and unbound in AttachmentChips, and shows empty occurrences return early while plain-phase chips evaluate busy and throw.
Explains the render exception is caught by the slot error boundary, unmounting the whole dock entry while the separate attach-button slot survives, with diagnostics only in the browser console.

Uses the v0.2.10 shipped expression to establish the baseline bug, proposes data-present plain-phase and rollback/re-add isolation, and discusses feature.diff inconsistencies and extra scoping defects without overclaiming exact historical exercise.

Removes the dangling busy reference or requires properly scoped state, preserves the phase guard, hardens record items and DOM target closest access, and scopes hover image lookups inside record/status scope.
Proposes a plain-phase data-present mount test asserting chip/remove control exists and no boundary error, and explains why empty-state tests and node --check miss runtime free identifiers.
